Exact17 child24 semantic audit found a theorem-bank miner bug: named_order=1 was incorrectly interpreted as cyclic reversal of order0. In Lean, NamedOrder 1 only swaps raw labels 9 and 12 at canonical positions 5/6; cyclic reversal is the separate Orientation parameter. The independent child24 export validator correctly caught the mismatch because the claimed bisector orbit did not cut the motivating model. I have patched the miner to select the actual NamedOrder table and am rebanking child24 from a clean rescan. Do not rely on old named_order1 model-hit provenance from this miner without rescanning. Previously emitted general Lean clauses remain source-clean/sound; the affected claim is that they were the occurrences seen in those models. Child25 was never provisioned.
